Then they decided to break up and when they broke up, that day, when I came home from school my father had got a player piano and the dishes were in the sink and she took the car and when I walked in the door he was playing this player piano and I says, 'Good gracious, that's music,' and then things began to sink in a little more. So we were washing dishes together and he tried to explain to me that…
Let's go back a little bit here for a minute, I just want to get the sequence of this straight. Now, you were born in Lansing and shortly after you were born, your mother and father split up...?
